chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
One who circumambulates this House seven times, Allah, the Exalted, will write for him six thousand good deeds, erase from him six thousand misdeeds, and elevate him six thousand degrees.
And in the narration of Ibn 'Ammar: And He will fulfill for him six thousand needs.
And Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Fulfilling the need of a believer is better than circumambulating [the Ka'bah] ten times.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for circumambulating the Ka'bah seven times according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the immense spiritual merit of circumambulating the Ka'bah seven times, promising six thousand good deeds, the erasure of six thousand sins, and the elevation of six thousand ranks. He further elevates the practical act of fulfilling a believer's need above ten circumambulations, underscoring the Shia emphasis on social solidarity and relieving distress as superior to ritual worship alone.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 116. It has been reported that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:
One who circumambulates around this House (i.e. the Ka'bah) seven times, Allah will write for him six thousand good deeds and erase six thousand misdeeds and elevate him six thousand degrees.
According to Ibn 'Ammar's narration, 'And fulfill for him six thousand needs.'
